import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

def _fit(X, y, it=30):
    w = np.zeros(X.shape[1])
    for _ in range(it):
        p = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(X @ w, -30, 30)))
        g = X.T @ (y - p)
        H = (X * (p * (1 - p))[:, None]).T @ X + 1e-6 * np.eye(X.shape[1])
        step = np.linalg.solve(H, g)
        w += step
        if np.abs(step).max() < 1e-8:
            break
    p = np.clip(1 / (1 + np.exp(-X @ w)), 1e-12, 1 - 1e-12)
    return np.sum(y * np.log(p) + (1 - y) * np.log(1 - p))

def design(feats):
    x = np.asarray(feats.x, float)
    y = np.asarray(feats.y, float)
    n, p = x.shape
    ids = list(feats.ids)
    labs = sorted(set(feats.stratum))
    base = [np.ones(n)] + [np.array([s == l for s in feats.stratum], float) for l in labs[1:]]
    B = np.column_stack(base)
    R = np.corrcoef(x, rowvar=False)
    alpha = 0.01 / p
    sel = []
    ll0 = _fit(B, y)
    while len(sel) < MAX_DRIVERS:
        best, bstat = None, 0.0
        cur = np.column_stack([B] + [x[:, [j]] for j in sel])
        for j in range(p):
            if j in sel or any(abs(R[j, k]) >= 0.6 for k in sel):
                continue
            st = 2 * (_fit(np.column_stack([cur, x[:, j]]), y) - ll0)
            if st > bstat:
                best, bstat = j, st
        if best is None or stats.chi2.sf(bstat, 1) > alpha:
            break
        sel.append(best)
        ll0 = _fit(np.column_stack([B] + [x[:, [j]] for j in sel]), y)
    # backward survival check
    keep = []
    full = np.column_stack([B] + [x[:, [j]] for j in sel])
    llf = _fit(full, y)
    for i, j in enumerate(sel):
        red = np.delete(full, B.shape[1] + i, axis=1)
        if stats.chi2.sf(2 * (llf - _fit(red, y)), 1) <= alpha:
            keep.append(j)
    sel = keep
    # pairwise product screen (including squares)
    cur = np.column_stack([B] + [x[:, [j]] for j in sel])
    llc = _fit(cur, y)
    npair = p * (p + 1) // 2
    prods, pbest = [], None
    for a in range(p):
        for b in range(a, p):
            cols = [cur, x[:, a] * x[:, b]] + [x[:, [k]] for k in {a, b} if k not in sel]
            Xt = np.column_stack(cols)
            st = 2 * (_fit(Xt, y, 12) - _fit(np.column_stack(cols[:1] + cols[2:]), y, 12))
            pv = stats.chi2.sf(st, 1)
            if pv < 0.01 / npair and (pbest is None or pv < pbest[0]):
                pbest = (pv, a, b)
    drivers = [ids[j] for j in sel]
    if pbest is not None:
        _, a, b = pbest
        prods = [(ids[a], ids[b])]
        for k in (a, b):
            if ids[k] not in drivers and len(drivers) < MAX_DRIVERS:
                drivers.append(ids[k])
    cols = list(dict.fromkeys(drivers))
    return Design(drivers=tuple(drivers), columns=tuple(cols), products=tuple(prods), loadings={})
